description: This file defines the PersistentStore class, which implements a plugin for persistent storage in the WPEFramework, including nested classes for configuration and notifications, as well as interfaces for handling store changes and remote connection events.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: A plugin class managing persistent storage, including configuration, event notifications, remote connection handling, and API endpoints for store operations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container storing parameters like path, key, max size, and limits.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification callback class for store update events, converting internal store notifications into plugin events.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification class for remote connection events, handling connection activation and deactivation.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the hosting service.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the persistent store.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace from the store.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Gets the total size of stored data.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: PersistentStore::endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: PersistentStore::event_onValueChanged
methods.description: Event invoked when a store value is changed.
